title: Specific brainstem nuclei generate primordial feelings

statements.text: A set of brainstem nuclei, the nucleus tractus solitarius, the parabrachial nucleus and the nuclei of the periaqueductal gray, is the proposed basis for the primordial feelings of the living body. These are not the nuclei of the ascending reticular activating system, which serve wakefulness and attention.
